title: Integrate RBAC v2 + SAML event enrichment into audit ingestion with tenant-aware partitioning and cost controls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Extend the audit ingestion pipeline to accept RBAC v2 decision events and SAML/SSO identity context, enrich logs with authoritative role binding snapshots, and apply tenant-aware partitioning and cost-aware retention policies. This ticket covers schema design, ingestion transforms, indexing strategy, hot/cold partition lifecycle, backpressure behavior when indexing lags, and the rollout plan (canary + full). The change should enable security teams to reconstruct authorization decisions with full context (actor, role set, scope, SSO identity attributes) while bounding storage costs for long-tail tenants.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Ingested events include normalized fields for rbac_role_snapshot, rbac_decision_id, saml_idp, saml_nameid, and tenant_id for all RBACv2 decision streams.
2) Index mapping added without an index explosion: tenant_id + time-based shards + role_hash used to avoid small-shard churn.
3) Retention policy enforces tenant-tiered TTL: default 90d, low-tier 30d, compliance-tier 365d; enforcement via lifecycle manager with documented override API.
4) Cost-controls: automatic cold-tier spill to compacted blobs for events older than 30d for non-compliance tenants, with a size-based throttle to prevent egress storms.
5) Rollout: canary on 5% of traffic in us-west for two weeks with no >10% ingest latency regression and no lost events.
6) Observability: dashboards for per-tenant ingest rate, indexing lag, shard count, and storage spend; alerts for indexing lag >5m or shard count growth >20% in 1hr.
7) Smoke tests and end-to-end replay completed; docs updated and runbook created.
notes:
Design trade-offs considered: embedding full RBAC binding snapshots increases per-event size (~+120 bytes) but avoids subsequent joins for audits. Alternative was storing pointers to binding artifacts which reduces size but complicates reconstructing historical decisions if bindings change; chose snapshotting for audit fidelity. To mitigate cost, snapshots are compressed and deduplicated via role_hash; compacted blob format for older events reduces storage by ~6x. Performance: prototype revealed KV cache pressure—we will emit a compacted role table to the metadata service to allow lightweight enrichment during hot path.
Security: SAML attributes are sensitive; fields must be redaction-aware and obey tenant compliance flags. KMS policies and field-level masking are required when retention >90d.
Open questions: how to surface tenant-tier assignment to the ingestion pipeline efficiently, and whether we should expose per-tenant retention settings to self-serve console in this release (deferred to PM roadmap).
rollout_plan:
Phase A: Staging integration + synthetic replay verification (3 days).
Phase B: Canary (5% traffic, us-west) + 48h watch with daily storage delta checks (2w).
Phase C: 25% sweep (multi-region) + SLA smoke tests (1w).
Phase D: Global rollout with manifest migration + migration backfill for 30-day window.
Fallback: route to legacy minimal-audit stream (no enrichment) if indexing lag exceeds threshold; automatic circuit-breaker and alerting to oncall.
migration_steps:
1) Deploy enrichment transforms to a shadow pipeline in staging and run 7d replay.
2) Create new index template and lifecycle policy (hot/cold/compact blob).
3) Start canary ingestion with sampled traffic and monitor indexing lag and cost.
4) Gradually flip traffic and run backfill for last 30d using replayer.
5) Retire shadow pipeline after verification and update consumers to read new fields.
6) Run compaction job for >30d events to compacted blobs and validate retrieval latency.
monitoring_and_alerts:
Dashboards: 'Audit Ingest Health', 'RBACv2 Enrichment Metrics', 'Tenant Storage Spend'.
Key metrics: enriched_events_per_min, avg_enrichment_ms, indexing_lag_seconds, shard_count, compact_blob_spill_rate, per_tenant_storage_bytes.
Alerts: indexing_lag_seconds > 300s sustained for 5m (P0), shard_count growth >20% in 1h (P1), compact_blob_spill_rate >10% (P1).
Oncall runbook link included in links.
